exposure: Severe maternal outcome (near miss or death)
outcome: Frequency of COVID-19-related near miss and deaths during pregnancy or postpartum
Clinical, epidemiological, and laboratory characteristics of women with severe maternal outcomes
cohort: 463 hospitalized pregnant and postpartum women with a diagnosis of COVID-19 confirmed by RT-PCR, from five tertiary hospitals in northeastern Brazil
finding: This study found a low COVID-19-related maternal near miss ratio of 1.6/1000 live births and a high COVID-19-related maternal mortality ratio of 84.81/100,000 live births, with a high mortality index.
mod_finding: The majority of patients with severe maternal outcomes required a Cesarean section (76.6%).
